digest.component_or_area: tickets repository reclaim & epoch guard deployment
propositions: Execute a one-time atomic force-with-lease rewrite of the tickets branch to reclaim ~92% of space after epoch-blind writer risk is closed by quiescence and runtime proofs rather than elapsed time.
Establish operator-confirmed zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers as a hard gate before tracker convergence, pin deletion, strip execution, or publication.

Verify pre-publication correctness on a fresh unfiltered clone: identity normalization hash identical pre/post, old-tip non-ancestry confirmed, commit/merge counts unchanged, and verify-identity reports identical ignoring rewritten SHAs.

Converge review-bot persistent clone via SSM after publication and treat the first post-window Gerrit LLM-Review vote (the rebar.toml enforce_since re-pin) as the deterministic canonical first write to measure size-pack growth and non-resurrection.

Land the identity.enforce_since re-pin through Gerrit at the mapped post-rewrite SHA with require_authenticated=false to avoid CI deadlock, then re-enable workflows and validate via green reconcile-bridge run or operator-approved signed CLI substitute.

Confirm all 12 operator-attested and code-verifiable acceptance criteria: pre-publication receipts, deployed review-bot SHA/refusal, host executable/refusal, tree/pack/ancestry/identity measures, first-write receipt, default-clone non-resurrection, zero-session/MCP confirmation, landed identity.enforce_since, post-enable reconciliation (dry/live/canary), and fsck clean.
